subject: general
question: The exterior angle of a regular polygon is one-seventh of its interior angle. How many sides does the polygon have?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Ratio of **Exterior angle** : **Interior angle** = 1 : 7 Total ratio units = 1 + 7 = 8 units Sum of **Interior** and **Exterior** angles at a vertex = 180° 8 units = 180° ⇒ 1 unit (**Exterior angle**) = 180° ÷ 8 = 22.5° Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ **Exterior angle** = 360° ÷ 22.5° = 16 **∴ The correct answer is 16.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** **Given:** **Exterior angle** of a regular polygon = (1/7) × **Interior angle** **Formula Used:** 1. **Interior angle** + **Exterior angle** = 180° 2. Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ **Exterior angle** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/152e3f8dcccb0a580447defbb588e03c001d42e37dd0cc535e07ebd85d1e4859.png] **Calculations:** Let the **exterior angle** be e and the **interior angle** be i. ⇒ e = i / 7 ⇒ i = 7e ⇒ i + e = 180° ⇒ 7e + e = 180° ⇒ 8e = 180° ⇒ e = 180° ÷ 8 = 22.5° ⇒ n = 360° ÷ 22.5° ⇒ n = 16 **∴ The correct answer is 16.**
